# CalcFort - Free Online Calculators

> Fast, accurate calculators for mathematics, finance, health, engineering, and more.

## About

CalcFort provides 90+ free online calculators covering:
- Mathematics (basic, scientific, graphing, fractions, percentages)
- Health & Fitness (BMI, BMR, calorie, protein, heart rate)
- Financial (loan, mortgage, investment, budget, currency converter)
- Engineering (electrical, resistor, capacitor, subnet, Ohm's law)
- Automotive (MPG, fuel cost, EV range, tire size)
- Construction (paint, concrete, roofing, stairs, tile, area, volume)
- Conversions (unit converter, binary, Roman numerals, Morse code)
- Everyday tools (timezone, countdown, date, age, time)

## Key Features

- **Fast & Accurate**: Instant calculations with precise results
- **No Sign-up Required**: All calculators are free to use
- **Mobile Friendly**: Works seamlessly on all devices
- **Detailed Explanations**: Learn while you calculate
- **90+ Tools**: Comprehensive collection across multiple categories
